A Vision Dictionary

Version history

All updates are consolidated into the current release.

Version 3.0.15

September 5, 2026

Version 3.0.15 adds shared Super Escalation credit and removes the visible administrator email.

  • Multiple techniciansSuper Escalations can credit additional Completed By technicians from the active shift roster.
  • Equal point splittingThe 150 points are divided evenly between every selected technician while the shift total remains 150 points.
  • Role-based administrationSafe Sync v6 uses a protected administrator role record instead of a hard-coded email address in the app or rules.

Version 3.0.14

September 5, 2026

Version 3.0.14 simplifies the generated report actions.

  • One email actionEmail report shares the wide shift-report PNG and lets the user choose an email app.
  • Duplicate removedThe overlapping Share report action has been removed.
  • Clear fallbackIf the browser cannot share image attachments, the PNG downloads and an email draft opens.

Version 3.0.13

September 5, 2026

Version 3.0.13 makes dense desktop shift reports shorter and easier to scan.

  • Escalations below PMsPM entries now use the full report width first, with Escalation entries flowing underneath instead of beside them.
  • Adaptive escalation gridShorter escalation lists use three columns, while lists with eight or more entries use four columns per row.
  • Less unused spaceThe new reading order removes the large blank area that appeared when the escalation list was much longer than the PM list.

Version 3.0.12

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.12 adds 150-point Super Escalations to Daily Tasks.

  • Super Escalation menuA dedicated section mirrors the escalation editor with Process, Machine, Vision, Comment, Completed By, edit, and delete controls.
  • 150-point scoringEach saved Super Escalation is worth 150 points in completion, contributor credit, totals, shift history, and exports.
  • Reports and synchronizationSuper Escalations appear in mobile and desktop shift reports and synchronize safely as their own shared collection.

Version 3.0.11

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.11 adds Thickness to the LNS vision menus.

  • Thickness vision choiceThickness is now available when LNS is selected in Daily Tasks PM and escalation entries.
  • Escalation form supportThe standalone Escalation Format LNS vision menu includes the same Thickness choice.

Version 3.0.10

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.10 gives the desktop shift report a cleaner, professional reading order.

  • Summary-first layoutTop Contributor, Work Contribution, and Summary Totals now form one aligned summary row.
  • Activity beneath the summaryPM and escalation entries now flow below the summary row, followed by completed NGM error-proofing work.
  • Prominent shift handoffThe handoff note is displayed in a full-width highlighted panel at the bottom of the image.
  • Desktop sharing availableThe desktop-share control remains visible and downloads the PNG when native file sharing is unavailable.

Version 3.0.9

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.9 gives desktop shift-report images a wider landscape layout.

  • Landscape desktop reportThe report title and three completion metrics now share the first row, leaving more room for report details.
  • Balanced activity columnsPM and escalation entries appear side by side, with PM entries arranged in a compact two-column grid.
  • Compact lower sectionNGM error-proofing entries spread across three columns, with the shift handoff note beside them.

Version 3.0.8

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.8 makes report image sharing reliable across supported phones and computers.

  • Prepared image sharingMobile and desktop report images are created when the report opens, so the Share buttons can launch the system share sheet directly from your tap.
  • Desktop download fallbackA new Download desktop image button saves the wide PNG when the browser cannot share image files.
  • Clear share resultsThe desktop Share button no longer silently sends text when an image cannot be shared.

Version 3.0.7

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.7 reduces clutter in the saved PM and escalation lists.

  • Extra-compact saved rowsSaved entries now place their summary, status, Edit, and Delete controls on one compact row with tighter spacing.
  • Full details preservedLong titles and comments are shortened in the list, while Edit still opens every saved field with its complete value.

Version 3.0.6

September 4, 2026

Version 3.0.6 repairs the My Tasks allocation filter.

  • Allocation filteringChoosing Allocation 1, 2, or 3 now hides the other allocations' Black Frame, Cell Tracking, and PKG checks while keeping shared shift tasks visible.
  • Clear selection feedbackThe matching allocation summary card is highlighted while its filter is active.

Version 3.0.5

September 3, 2026

Version 3.0.5 makes signing in and choosing a shift strictly read-only.

  • Load-only shift selectionChoosing a date or shift can only open the matching cloud record. It never queues, creates, or updates a shared shift.
  • User-edit-only creationA missing shift is created only after someone makes a real content change such as checking a task, entering a name, or adding a note.
  • Safe Sync v5The matching Firestore rules reject writes from earlier app builds so a cached copy cannot reintroduce the shift-selection bug.

Version 3.0.4

September 3, 2026

Version 3.0.4 adds server-enforced protection against blank-form replacement and older cached app builds.

  • Safe Sync v4Every cloud write now carries a changing write ID and current sync-protocol version. The matching Firestore rules reject writes from older cached builds, preventing an outdated phone or tab from clearing shared data.
  • Non-destructive openingWhen a shared shift first opens, completed tasks and populated fields from either Firestore or the phone backup are preserved. Blank values never replace populated work during sign-in.
  • Bulk-clear safety stopA write that unexpectedly removes several pieces of shift data at once is blocked and the last confirmed cloud state is restored on screen.

Version 3.0.3

September 2, 2026

Version 3.0.3 prevents a new sign-in or device from replacing an existing shared shift with a blank local form.

  • Cloud-first shift openingThe app waits for a confirmed Firestore server snapshot before allowing queued changes to save, so stale browser cache and blank phone drafts cannot overwrite shared work.
  • Safe first-load mergeIf someone makes a change while the shift is opening, only the fields changed during that loading window are merged into the shared shift; existing task responses, names, notes, PMs, and escalations remain intact.

Version 3.0.2

September 2, 2026

Version 3.0.2 keeps Cell Tracking Reading Rate work visible without lowering the overall shift-completion percentage.

  • Completion scoringCell Tracking Reading Rate checks remain saved, synchronized, reportable, and eligible for allocation and technician points, but they are excluded from the Total shift completion percentage in Daily Tasks, dashboards, and reports.

Version 3.0.1

August 31, 2026

Version 3.0.1 repairs Google sign-in guidance and shared Daily Tasks synchronization.

  • Firebase permissionsThe matching Firestore rules now accept the optional Shift Handoff Note field, so both new and existing shared shifts can save successfully.
  • Google sign-inA downloaded HTML copy now directs users to the hosted app, while mobile pop-up and Firebase errors provide clear recovery instructions.
  • Queued cloud savesTask edits made while a shift is connecting, reconnecting, or changing are retained and saved after the shared shift is ready.

Version 3.0

August 25, 2026

Version 3.0 consolidates the complete mobile production toolkit and adds named Completed By attribution throughout Daily Tasks.

  • Named task attributionLead, Allocation 1–3, and any OT Support names populate Completed By menus. Checking Black Frame, Cell Tracking Reading Rate, or any PKG machine check now reveals its own required Completed By dropdown, so contribution points go to the person who actually performed the work.
  • Local Admin and dashboardA PIN-protected Admin screen can rename, reprice, archive, add, import, and export Daily Tasks. The new local dashboard summarizes the shift saved on the current phone, and the HTML exporter creates a clean standalone template without technician names or shift data.
  • Role-based sign-inThe login menu lists Technician first and Admin second. Technician sessions cannot see or directly open the Admin tab; signing in as Admin with the correct PIN reveals and unlocks the Task Manager.
  • Daily Tasks and scoringDate, Shift, and NGM Error Proofing A/B are required before the checklist unlocks. The standard shift contains 81 scheduled items worth 2,435 base points, plus 50 points for every completed PM and escalation. Allocation completion still tracks the assigned A1, A2, and A3 workload separately from individual contribution.
  • Shift-aware schedulesB2 and G2 automatically move scheduled times forward 12 hours and use the night-shift NGM Error Proofing machine sets. Black Frame, six Cell Tracking checks, 42 PKG machine checks, No Response, three LNS IQ checks, six LNS TOP NG checks, and five selected NGM Error Proofing entries are included.
  • Technician roster and recoverySaved names replace generic Lead and allocation labels across menus and reports, multiple OT Support technicians can be added, and Daily Tasks recover on the same phone for 16 hours. Older active drafts preserve completed core work by assigning it to its original allocation during migration.
  • PM and escalation trackingProcess-filtered Process, Machine, and Vision fields, Completed By selection, automatic completion on save, 50-point scoring, and compact saved lists with Edit and Delete controls reduce scrolling.
  • Compact shift reportingThe screenshot-ready Shift Report shows Date, Shift, completion, earned and missed points, work contribution, top contributor, that leader's PM/Error Proofing/escalation counts, missed-work totals, and PM/escalation totals. The same concise report can be copied, shared, printed, or saved as PDF.
  • Mobile organizationDaily Tasks use collapsible numbered sections, per-section point summaries, Expand All, Collapse All, Incomplete Only, missing-attribution highlighting, and a sticky shift-progress display. The TOP badge and report spacing are optimized for clean phone screenshots.
  • Production copy toolsPKG Update, LNS IQ Check, Cell Recognition Rate, L&S Top 3 NG, and Escalation Format produce copy-ready updates with draft recovery and mobile-friendly previews.
  • Guides and troubleshootingSearchable mobile Work Instructions and process-aware Troubleshooting cover LNS, PKG, Cell Tracking, and EOL using privacy-cleaned historical records and English technical translations.
  • App experienceThe standalone PWA includes Technician sign-in protection, theme-matched V icons, multiple visual themes, English/Korean interface support, and rotating quotes. The unreliable No Response screenshot scanner was removed while the scheduled manual No Response check remains.
